replies.author: Princezz_Dubstep
replies.body:
Contact support@avicus.net to file a report on a Staff Member.

You apparently have an E-Mail, considering you have a Minecraft account.

However, you may contact Fluenza_ or AviGill over Skype regarding your issue with other Staff Members. They will get back to you ASAP.

Be patient, they won't reply the second you send a Message, but they will do their best to reply back! (:
